window_head_sha.description: CCE-109: on a time-truncated run, the real window HEAD the run covered (head_sha then holds the mid-window cursor). Read by the CCE-43 same-hour rerun guard.

dismissed_gap_flags.description: Operator-set dismissals. Keys are {owner}/{name}#{pr}. Values are dismissal notes (free text).

deferral_counts.description: CCE-140: consecutive-deferral count per PR. Keys are {owner}/{name}#{pr}, the same shape as dismissed_gap_flags. Runner-owned, not operator-edited. An entry is dropped as soon as its PR is processed or skipped, so a quiescent pipeline carries no entries and the key is absent entirely.

skipped_prs.description: CCE-140: PRs abandoned after run.deferral_skip_threshold consecutive deferrals. Append-only — the runner never removes an entry. Absent means no PR has ever been skipped; the key is never seeded empty.

pages.description: lens/page_hint targets this PR still owed when it was skipped. Empty when the admission gate never reached the PR, so no page was ever routed for it.

pr_summaries.description: CCE-159: pr-summarizer output reused across runs. Keys are {owner}/{name}#{pr}, the same shape as deferral_counts. An entry is only served when its merge_sha still matches the PR's and its fingerprint still matches agents/pr-summarizer.md, so editing the agent or rewriting history invalidates it. Runner-owned, not operator-edited. Absent means nothing has ever been cached; the key is never seeded empty.

fingerprint.description: Truncated sha256 of agents/pr-summarizer.md at the time the summary was produced.

last_seen_at.description: Refreshed on every run this PR appears in the window. Entries unseen for PR_SUMMARY_RETENTION_DAYS are evicted, which bounds growth without wiping the cache when a window shrinks transiently.

summary.description: Raw pr-summarizer output. pr_number is re-stamped from the PR on reuse, so the stored echo is not authoritative.
